author_note_body: I’m still learning the best settings for different subjects. If you’ve found a photogrammetry preset that gives you a cleaner mesh, I’d love to hear about it. Send me a message on Pinokio with the engine and settings you used so I can try them in Foundry. Thanks for helping improve the preview!
text_four_view_turnaround_front_side_thr: Four-view turnaround: front, side, three-quarter and back
text_check_that_the_object_keeps_its_sha: Check that the object keeps its shape and details throughout the orbit.
text_sets_the_target_for_this_export_def: Sets the target for this export. Default: {value}
text_jade_guardian_reconstructed_from_a_: Jade guardian reconstructed from a virtual orbit
text_in_a_traditional_scan_photos_taken_: In a traditional scan, photos taken around an object give photogrammetry the views it needs. Virtual Turntable uses H3 to generate those views as a 360° video from one image, then reconstructs a mesh by matching details across its frames.
text_choose_meshroom_alicevision_or_colm: Choose Meshroom / AliceVision or COLMAP + OpenMVS. Review the result and optionally refine with Hi3D.
text_reconstructing_the_mesh_from_orbit_: Reconstructing the mesh from orbit frames
text_finishing_the_mesh_and_projecting_o: Finishing the mesh and projecting orbit colors
text_reset_to_restore_the_full_text: Reset to restore the full text.
text_virtual_turntable_uses_ai_assisted_: Virtual Turntable uses AI-assisted photogrammetry to turn one reference image into a 3D mesh. In a traditional scan, you take photos from different angles around a real object. Here, AI generates a 360° orbit video, and photogrammetry matches details across the frames.
text_the_mesh_comes_out_best_when_the_ob: The mesh comes out best when the object keeps the same shape and details throughout the orbit.
text_preserved_more_carving_and_surface_: In the jade guardian test, Meshroom gave us clear carving and a usable textured starting mesh. The result had open edges and a spike above the mane.
text_pruna_p_h3_image_minimax_h3_and_the: Pruna P-H3 Image, MiniMax H3 and the orbit LoRA use territory-restricted terms. See the terms and MiniMax's separate license application for use in an excluded territory. These terms can apply to outputs, including when the video is an intermediate.
help_turnaround_prompt: Describe how H3 should preserve the subject across all four views.
help_turnaround_panel_size: Pixels per square panel. More pixels cost VRAM.
help_turnaround_seed: Change the seed to generate a different sheet.
help_turnaround_crops: Four normalized crop rectangles in front, side, three-quarter and back order.
help_orbit_prompt: Motion instruction for H3. Ask for one smooth turn around a stationary subject.
help_orbit_subject_direction: Add subject-specific direction such as keeping a carving or asymmetric part in place.
help_orbit_width: Video width in pixels. Higher resolution uses more memory.
help_orbit_height: Video height in pixels. Higher resolution uses more memory.
help_orbit_length: Number of generated frames. At 24 fps, 73 frames give about three seconds. Longer clips cost memory and time.
help_orbit_fps: Playback frames per second. This controls how fast the finished clip plays.
help_orbit_seed: Change the seed to try a different orbit.
help_orbit_steps: Denoising iterations. More steps take longer.
help_orbit_lora_strength: How strongly Pablo Dawson’s LoRA guides the orbit motion.
help_orbit_side_fraction: Position of the side guide as a fraction of the orbit.
help_orbit_three_quarter_fraction: Position of the three-quarter guide as a fraction of the orbit.
help_orbit_back_fraction: Position of the rear guide as a fraction of the orbit.
help_orbit_margin: Empty border around each normalized view. More margin leaves fewer pixels for details.
help_orbit_background: Gray level behind the subject guides, from black (0) to white (1).
help_orbit_feedforward_chunks: Splits transformer work into more pieces to reduce peak memory.
help_orbit_attention_chunks: Splits attention to reduce peak memory. More chunks may run slower.
help_orbit_decode_tile: Spatial video decoder tile size. Smaller tiles use less VRAM.
help_orbit_decode_frames: Temporal decoder tile length. Smaller groups use less VRAM.
help_orbit_release_previous_models: Release the preceding image stage’s model allocations before guide masking.
help_frames_max_frames: Maximum number of evenly spaced usable frames. More frames cost reconstruction time.
help_frames_max_edge: Maximum frame side in pixels. Lower it to reduce reconstruction cost.
help_frames_drop_loop_endpoint: Discard the final frame when it repeats the opening view.
help_frames_exclude_indices: Comma-separated frame indices or ranges to skip, starting at zero. Remove pauses, warped views or duplicates.
help_frames_batch_size: Frames masked at once. Larger batches need more VRAM.
help_frames_mask_threshold: Confidence required to retain a foreground pixel. Higher values can remove fine edges.
help_frames_erode_pixels: Shrink the foreground mask by this many pixels. This may remove thin details.
help_frames_release_previous_models: Free orbit models before frame masking.
help_frames_release_gpu: Free the masking model before running the reconstruction engine.
help_meshroom_depth_downscale: Downsample depth inputs by this factor to trade detail for speed and memory.
help_meshroom_depth_tile: Depth work tile in pixels. Smaller tiles reduce peak GPU use.
help_meshroom_neighbor_cameras: Number of nearby views considered for depth. Larger values increase work.
help_meshroom_feature_density: Search for more matching points, which can help registration and cost time.
help_meshroom_min_2d_motion: Minimum matching motion in pixels. A higher value rejects nearly identical views.
help_meshroom_initial_fov: Assumed horizontal field of view in degrees. Use Auto to let Meshroom estimate it.
help_meshroom_camera_calibration: Fix the selected lens or estimate it from the images.
help_meshroom_minimum_checked_fov: Reject solved cameras below this horizontal field of view.
help_meshroom_maximum_checked_fov: Reject solved cameras above this horizontal field of view.
help_meshroom_texture_size: Atlas edge in pixels. Larger atlases preserve detail and use more memory.
help_meshroom_max_input_points: Maximum input samples accepted by the mesher.
help_meshroom_max_mesh_points: Maximum points in the dense mesh. Raise to retain detail at higher cost.
help_meshroom_cpu_threads: CPU concurrency for the native engine.
help_meshroom_timeout_minutes: Stop the native job when this time limit is reached.
help_meshroom_advanced_overrides: JSON keyed by AliceVision graph node. Supply named native controls such as DepthMapFilter_1 consistency and MeshFiltering_1 smoothing.
help_colmap_openmvs_camera_model: Camera model used for feature alignment. Distortion models give the solver more freedom.
help_colmap_openmvs_shared_camera: Use a shared lens for all frames, appropriate when the orbit holds one focal length.
help_colmap_openmvs_initial_focal_factor: Initial focal length divided by image size when automatically fitting the lens.
help_colmap_openmvs_camera_calibration: Hold a chosen horizontal field of view or estimate the lens.
help_colmap_openmvs_initial_fov: Assumed horizontal field of view in degrees for fixed pinhole calibration.
help_colmap_openmvs_gpu_features: Use the GPU for COLMAP feature matching and extraction.
help_colmap_openmvs_gpu_index: CUDA device index for the native reconstruction.
help_colmap_openmvs_max_features: Maximum matched features per image. Higher limits cost RAM and time.
help_colmap_openmvs_depth_downscale: 0 uses full depth resolution, 1 halves it and 2 quarters it.
help_colmap_openmvs_max_resolution: Limit the depth image size in pixels to manage GPU memory.
help_colmap_openmvs_neighbor_views: Number of nearby images used to estimate depth. More views cost time.
help_colmap_openmvs_refine_mesh: Run OpenMVS photo-consistency refinement on the initial mesh.
help_colmap_openmvs_refine_on_gpu: Use CUDA for OpenMVS refinement. Turning this off uses the CPU.
help_colmap_openmvs_refine_decimation: Input reduction for OpenMVS refinement. 1 preserves density and 0 uses automatic reduction.
help_colmap_openmvs_texture_size: Maximum texture atlas edge in pixels.
help_colmap_openmvs_cpu_threads: CPU concurrency for the native tools and texture projection.
help_colmap_openmvs_timeout_minutes: Stop the native job when this time limit is reached.
help_colmap_openmvs_advanced_overrides: JSON keyed by feature, match, mapper, dense, mesh, refine or texture. Use options from the pinned native tool help.
help_refinement_refine: Use Hi3D to refine geometry from a matching orbit image. It can introduce plausible new details.
help_refinement_reference_frame: Use the first registered camera automatically, or choose a matched frame index starting at 0.
help_refinement_resolution: Hi3D mesh detail resolution. Higher settings cost GPU memory.
help_refinement_steps: Hi3D iterations. More iterations take longer.
help_refinement_seed: Change the seed for a different Hi3D result.
help_refinement_cpu_offload: Move inactive Hi3D modules to system RAM when supported to save VRAM.
help_refinement_attention: Attention backend used by the existing Hi3D runtime.
help_refinement_cleanup_resolution: Resolution of the solid remesh. Higher values can retain thinner detail at higher cost.
help_refinement_smoothing: Number of cleanup smoothing passes. More passes soften bumps and fine details.
help_refinement_band: Thickness of the remesh surface band, in voxel units.
help_orbit_turbo: Enable the tested Larry Turbo v4 adapter for the eight-step orbit recipe.
help_orbit_turbo_strength: Strength of the Larry Turbo v4 speed adapter when enabled.
help_orbit_sampler: Sampling method used for the orbit denoising steps.
help_orbit_scheduler: How noise levels are distributed across the orbit denoising steps.
text_captured_the_overall_shape_in_the_s: The tuned COLMAP and OpenMVS test recovered more of the pedestal opening and avoided the mane spike. Fine carving was softer in the geometry, and some texture areas were missed.
help_meshroom_finish_segmenter: Use parallel GPU UV charting or slower adaptive CPU charting.
help_meshroom_finish_uv_resolution: Atlas size used to plan UV charts.
help_meshroom_finish_uv_padding: Pixels between UV charts to help avoid bleeding.
help_meshroom_finish_uv_weld_distance: Fraction of the mesh extent used to join nearby vertices for UV charting. Zero selects automatic.
help_meshroom_finish_unwrap_method: AliceVision chart method if the input needs UVs.
help_meshroom_finish_fill_texture_holes: Fill gaps in the texture atlas. Geometry stays the same.
help_meshroom_finish_weight_by_projected: Favor larger projected faces. Keep this off if dense meshes produce a dark texture.
help_meshroom_finish_memory_gib: AliceVision texture working memory in GiB. The process can allocate additional memory.
help_meshroom_finish_metallic: Uniform metalness of the photo texture. Use zero for stone, plastic and other non-metals.
help_meshroom_finish_roughness: Uniform roughness of the photo texture. Lower values make reflections sharper.
help_openmvs_finish_orientation: Use the reference camera to orient the result, or keep the native reconstruction axes.
help_openmvs_finish_ground: Center the asset and place its lowest point on the floor.
help_openmvs_finish_material: Choose the finish for the projected texture. Custom uses the next two controls.
help_openmvs_finish_custom_metallic: Metalness used with the Custom material.
help_openmvs_finish_custom_roughness: Roughness used with the Custom material.
help_openmvs_finish_outlier_threshold: Reject inconsistent projected samples using this threshold.
help_openmvs_finish_advanced_texture: JSON for additional native TextureMesh options, such as texture quality or seam leveling.
help_openmvs_finish_texture_triangle_tar: Reduce the mesh before projecting photos. More triangles keep finer geometry and take longer to texture. Full density can be much slower.
full_density_warning: Full-density projection can take much longer and use more memory. Choose a triangle limit for a faster finish. The dense clean mesh is preserved.
ux_custom_orbit_help: Choose a size, length, playback speed and sampling method below. Open the advanced settings for camera motion and memory controls.
ux_standard_short_help: 768 × 768 with full sampling. Start here for a short orbit at the usual resolution.
ux_low_vram_full_help: 512 × 512 with full sampling. The smaller frames use less GPU memory and can lose fine detail.
ux_size_low_help: Smaller frames save GPU memory and can soften fine detail.
ux_size_standard_help: The standard square frame for orbit reconstruction.
ux_size_custom_help: Use multiples of 32 pixels for both dimensions.
ux_length_help: A longer clip offers more frames to choose from and takes more time and memory to generate.
ux_length_custom_help: Use a supported frame count such as 73, 141 or 243. H3 accepts 5 plus a multiple of 17.
ux_speed_help: Higher playback speed shortens the clip. It keeps the same generated frames.
ux_sampling_turbo_help: Use Larry Turbo v4 with its eight-step sampler and schedule.
ux_sampling_full_help: Use the standard sampler and schedule. This takes longer and can produce a different result.
ux_sampling_custom_help: Set the steps, Turbo adapter, sampler and schedule yourself.
ux_heavy_video_help: This clip has more pixels across its frames than the default. It can take more GPU memory and time. Use the lower-VRAM preset if memory is tight.
ux_asset_name_help: Use a short name you’ll recognize in History and in the export ZIP.
ux_reference_help: Choose a clear image of one subject. Include the whole subject with a little space around it.
ux_invalid_video: Use dimensions divisible by 32 and a supported frame count such as 73, 141 or 243.
ux_invalid_guide_order: Set the guide times in order: three-quarter, side, then back.
ux_invalid_overlap: Set each decoder overlap to at most half the corresponding tile or frame group.
ux_changed_stage: To apply your edits, run this step again: {stage}. Earlier completed steps can be reused.
ux_finish_stage: Finish and package the selected exports
ux_review_earlier_step: Go to the step that needs updating
ux_resume_from_saved: Your settings were saved. Continue from the earliest step that needs updating.
ux_saved_steps_help: Completed steps are saved. A retry can reuse them with the same settings.
ux_refresh_views_help: Refresh views to see the frames selected for the new view count.
ux_rocket_intro: Rocket Mode runs the remaining steps automatically. Review the stages and files before starting.
ux_export_texture_size: Pixel size of the baked maps. Larger maps use more memory. Default: {value}.
ux_export_balanced_triangles: Triangle target for the balanced export. A higher target retains more detail. Default: {value}.
ux_export_compact_triangles: Triangle target for the compact export. Lower values make lighter meshes. Default: {value}.
ux_export_quad_count: Approximate number of quad faces. A higher target can keep more detail and take longer. Default: {value}.
ux_export_print_height_mm: Physical height of the print model in millimeters. Default: {value}.
ux_camera_range: Set the minimum field of view below the maximum.
ux_invalid_json: Enter a JSON object, or restore the default settings for this section.
ux_invalid_sigmas: Enter descending values between 1 and 0, separated by commas, ending in 0.
